apps/web/postcss.config.js.description: PostCSS configuration for the frontend. Enables TailwindCSS and Autoprefixer.

apps/web/tailwind.config.js.description: TailwindCSS configuration. Defines a premium design system with custom color palettes (ink, primary, accent), Inter typography, display scales, and motion tokens (glow-primary, lift shadows).

apps/web/src/app/globals.css.description: Global CSS styles. Implements the root design system using CSS variables for light/dark modes, custom scrollbars, and reusable Tailwind layer components (surface, focus-ring).

apps/web/src/app/layout.js.description: Root layout for the Next.js app. Configures SEO metadata, PWA manifests, and wraps the application in the ThemeProvider.

apps/web/src/app/page.js.description: Marketing landing page. High-fidelity design featuring a hero preview, feature mosaic, and pricing/CTA sections. Uses Framer Motion-like CSS animations for a premium feel.

apps/web/src/app/dashboard/layout.js.description: Main shell for the authenticated experience. Handles auth state persistence, workspace fetching, and provides the persistent WorkspaceRail and header.

apps/web/src/app/dashboard/page.js.description: Dashboard entry point. Automatically redirects the user to their last active workspace or the first available one.

apps/web/src/app/dashboard/[workspaceId].description: Workspace-specific layout. Initializes real-time socket connections for the current workspace, hydrates notifications/presence, and provides the workspace sidebar/navigation.
Workspace overview dashboard. Displays analytics tiles, goal completion charts, and 'In Flight' vs 'Just Shipped' goal summaries.
Workspace announcements feed. Lists posts with pinning, editing, and deletion capabilities. Includes rich-text composer and reaction hydration.
Workspace goals management. Provides status filtering (Not Started, In Progress, Completed) and goal creation via modal.
Detailed view of a single goal. Displays description, status management, nested milestones list, and activity audit feed.
Workspace action items (tasks). Supports toggling between Kanban board and List views. Handles task creation/editing via modal.
Workspace settings for admins. Allows editing workspace name, description, accent color, and icon upload. Includes 'Danger Zone' for deletion.

apps/web/src/app/invite/[token]/page.js.description: Public landing page for workspace invitations. Validates token status (expired/revoked), shows workspace preview, and handles acceptance for authenticated users.

apps/web/src/app/login/page.js.description: User login page. Uses the AuthShell wrapper and handles cookie-based authentication via the authStore.

apps/web/src/app/register/page.js.description: User registration page. Collects user details and automatically triggers initial workspace creation on success.

apps/web/src/app/onboarding/page.js.description: First-run onboarding page for new users. Prompts for workspace creation if no workspaces exist.

apps/web/src/components/auth/AuthShell.j.description: UI shell for authentication pages (login, register). Provides the layout and persistent branding elements.

apps/web/src/components/auth/TextField.j.description: Reusable styled input field for forms. Supports labels, hints, and error states with consistent design system styling.
